lines.text: Moving your feet isn't always a fault.
You swing hard and your feet move.
So you try to glue them to the ground.
Now you're stiff, and still off balance.
The problem is where your weight ends up.
Stuck on your back foot, or tipping toward the ball.
A wobbly finish is the clue.
Scottie Scheffler's feet move a lot.
His trail foot slides through the shot.
Coaches tie it to how hard he pushes into the ground.
That slide is his. You don't need to copy it.
Balance is easy to check, the app I'm building puts your filmed swing next to the checkpoint, so here's the test.
Finish tall, weight on your lead foot.
Now hold it for three seconds.
Can't hold it? Slow down until you can.
